rule: A cited governing equation does not validate this facade. Design ranges are sensitivity ranges, never confidence intervals.

sources.title: OpenCFD OpenFOAM 2312 atmospheric inlet and rough-ground source
sources.use: neutral logarithmic U, k, epsilon, friction velocity and sigmaEps consistency

sources.title: OpenCFD atmNutkWallFunction
sources.use: matched aerodynamic roughness at ground; z0 is an explicit isolated-building terrain scenario

sources.title: OpenCFD scalarTransport 2312 source
sources.use: steady passive scalar transport, molecular plus turbulent diffusivity; not a humid-air phase-change solver

sources.title: EnergyPlus conduction finite difference engineering reference
sources.use: implicit conduction and enthalpy framework; this package does not execute EnergyPlus

sources.title: DOE reference model IDF, medium office
sources.use: actual nonres_ext_wall_top layer properties; frozen primary IDF from Stage A, extraction in doe-wall.json

sources.title: Blocken and Carmeliet 2007, validation of wind-driven rain on low-rise building
sources.use: separate airflow/rain validation methodology; experimental data were not imported or used to claim validation here

sources.title: Rees and Garrett 2021, disdrometer sampling precision
sources.use: Marshall-Palmer shape N0=8000 m^-3 mm^-1, Lambda=4.1 R^-0.21 mm^-1 and sampling limitations; not local measured DSD

sources.title: OpenCFD SchillerNaumann drag source
sources.use: sphere drag CdRe=24(1+0.15Re^0.687) below1000, 0.44Re above; deformed large raindrops remain uncertain

sources.title: Mundo, Sommerfeld and Tropea 1995, droplet-wall collision
sources.use: K=We^0.5 Re^0.25 splash indicator, 57.7 threshold; neither CNF retention nor a secondary-drop model

sources.title: Primary droplet impact experiments, Soft Matter 2016
sources.use: cross-check of impact criterion and calibration limitations

sources.title: IAPWS ice Ih release
sources.use: thermodynamic reference for ice; full EOS is not implemented, near-zero constants are identified approximations

sources.title: IAPWS melting and sublimation curves
sources.use: phase-equilibrium context; constant zero-Celsius melting point approximation is declared

sources.title: IAPWS liquid water at 0.1 MPa
sources.use: reference for thermophysical property refinement; cp=4180 and mu=0.001 in current film are constant-property approximations, not this full formulation

sources.title: Basilisk primary Stefan reference implementation
sources.use: analytic Neumann relation used for numerical phase-front verification; not experimental validation

sources.title: OpenCFD 2112 release: velocityFilmShell and surface film interaction
sources.use: identifies distinction between a full surface-film collision model and the present independent Python smooth-film reference; that OpenFOAM film solver was not run

sources.title: Abu-Hamdeh 2003, soil thermal properties vs water content and density
sources.use: shows dependence on soil state; does not identify the actual soil of any selected city

sources.title: EnergyPlus ground-domain surface heat balance
sources.use: boundary-condition scope and omitted soil moisture/evapotranspiration in dry-ground scenario

sensitivity_parameters.name: film_plate_capacity_J_m2_K
sensitivity_parameters.status: derived from Stage-A emitter node capacity divided by active emitter area; constituent-property uncertainty remains in Stage A

sensitivity_parameters.name: z0_m
sensitivity_parameters.status: terrain scenario, not a measured urban roughness; grid wall-distance compatibility required

sensitivity_parameters.name: Prt
sensitivity_parameters.status: turbulent diffusivity closure sensitivity, no calibrated confidence interval
sensitivity_parameters.source: B03 algorithm; coefficient is a scenario

sensitivity_parameters.name: Sct
sensitivity_parameters.source: B03 algorithm; coefficient is a scenario

sensitivity_parameters.name: ground_k_W_m_K
sensitivity_parameters.source: B16 motivates uncertainty, not nominal identification

sensitivity_parameters.name: ground_cp_J_kg_K
sensitivity_parameters.status: dry-ground scenario, no soil moisture transport

sensitivity_parameters.name: deep_ground_C
sensitivity_parameters.status: design boundary, common controlled reference; not city-specific climatology

sensitivity_parameters.name: external_h_prior_W_m2_K
sensitivity_parameters.status: explicit engineering prior where CFD scalar flux is unqualified; not a paper-derived universal law

sensitivity_parameters.name: film_mu_Pa_s
sensitivity_parameters.status: constant water-viscosity approximation; cold liquid drainage can differ strongly

sensitivity_parameters.name: fusion_latent_J_kg
sensitivity_parameters.status: constant phase reference near zero Celsius

sensitivity_parameters.name: snow_density_kg_m3
sensitivity_parameters.status: scenario for thickness flag only; snow input is already water-equivalent mass, not inferred from depth

sensitivity_parameters.name: retained_fraction_after_splash
sensitivity_parameters.status: unidentified CNF/glass retention scenario; K threshold cannot determine it

sensitivity_parameters.name: thin_layer_limit_m
sensitivity_parameters.status: declared model-scope threshold; thick snow/ice requires normal-direction thermal resolution
